title: DSPy Streaming Module
summary: This module provides functionalities to enable incremental streaming of DSPy program outputs, allowing for real-time feedback and processing. It includes tools to wrap programs for streaming, listen for specific field updates, and format streams for external APIs.

nodes.label: Wrap DSPy Program for Streaming
nodes.title: Streamify DSPy Program
nodes.description: Transforms a DSPy program into an asynchronous generator that yields outputs incrementally, enabling real-time feedback and processing. It orchestrates stream listeners and handles async/sync conversion.

nodes.label: Monitor & Extract Field Streams
nodes.title: Stream Listener
nodes.description: Captures and processes incremental tokens from the underlying language model stream, extracting content for specific output fields based on adapter configurations (Chat, JSON, XML).

nodes.label: Convert Async to Sync Stream
nodes.title: Synchronous Stream Converter
nodes.description: Adapts an asynchronous streaming generator to a synchronous one, allowing DSPy programs to be used in synchronous contexts while retaining streaming capabilities.

nodes.label: Format Stream for OpenAI API
nodes.title: OpenAI Stream Formatter
nodes.description: Converts DSPy's internal streaming output into an OpenAI-compatible server-sent events (SSE) format, suitable for external API responses from a DSPy application.

nodes.label: Execute Async in New Event Loop
nodes.title: New Event Loop Executor
nodes.description: A utility to run an asynchronous coroutine within a newly created and managed asyncio event loop, useful for isolating async operations or running them from synchronous contexts.

nodes.label: DSPy Program (Module)
nodes.title: DSPy Program
nodes.description: The core DSPy program or module (e.g., dspy.Predict, dspy.Chain) that is being wrapped to enable streaming functionality.

nodes.label: Language Model Stream
nodes.title: LM Stream
nodes.description: Raw, incremental output stream received from an integrated Language Model client, containing token chunks.

nodes.label: OpenAI-Compatible API Output
nodes.title: OpenAI API Output
nodes.description: The final output stream formatted as server-sent events (SSE) for consumption by clients expecting OpenAI-style streaming responses.

nodes.label: Asyncify Utility
nodes.title: Asyncify Utility
nodes.description: A utility from the general_utilities module that converts synchronous functions into asynchronous coroutines for seamless integration into async workflows.

nodes.label: DSPy Prediction Object
nodes.title: Prediction Object
nodes.description: The final, complete prediction object generated by the DSPy program after all streaming chunks have been processed and aggregated.

nodes.label: Adapter Configuration
nodes.title: Adapter Config
nodes.description: Configuration details for different language model adapters (e.g., Chat, JSON, XML) used by StreamListener to interpret stream formats and extract fields.

groups.label: User-Facing API
groups.title: User-Facing API
groups.description: Components that provide the primary interface for enabling and consuming streaming functionality in DSPy programs.

groups.label: Stream Processing Logic
groups.title: Stream Processing Logic
groups.description: Core components responsible for handling the incremental processing, extraction, and adaptation of data within the streaming pipeline.

groups.label: Internal Utilities
groups.title: Internal Utilities
groups.description: Helper functions that support the underlying asynchronous operations and execution environment for streaming.
